title: Emptying a priced part's cost shows $0.00 straight away
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with a special-order part not yet received on line 1, category A, cost $100.00, priced at $121.50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the part's description to open Edit Part Request.
  3. Clear the Cost box.
  4. Click Save Part.
  5. Click the Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Edit Part Request opens with Cost 100.00 and Sell Price 121.50.

Step 3:

  • Sell Price changes to 0.00 at once, before saving.

Step 4:

  • The line shows $0.00, not the old $121.50.

Step 5:

  • The part's Priced by column names tier A.
